purpose: Native physical room relationship evidence for a new independent v3 requirements format. Observations are not universal gameplay mandates.
coordinateSystem: Positions are grid-local entity origins in tiles. Integer floor cells are floor(x),floor(y); centers ordinarily end in .5. Grid UID is scoped to the map. Rotation is the authored Transform rotation (radians in these samples).

method.source: Native map entities with map overrides merged over resolved current entity prototype inheritance; migration aliases applied as the map loader does. Map chunks decoded into actual floor cells.
method.closedDoorComponents: Four-neighbor floor flood blocking walls, full tile approximation of windows/grilles, and every Door (including curtains, shutters and firelocks). It ignores equipment and movable furniture. These IDs are audit-local conservative partitions, not authoritative room IDs or runtime paths.
method.sampleCustomerFloorPath: Four-neighbor path excluding those structural/door blockers plus all TableBase descendants. Movable objects, chairs and other equipment are not simulated. Used only to establish customer-floor continuity between sampled service sides.
method.access: For containerAccessProvider=board, resolve ContainerFill default electronics profile and record that board AccessReader. Direct outer AccessReader.access is not authoritative when a provider is configured. Runtime power, bolts, wires, access keys, spawned container overrides and emergency access are not simulated.
method.directionalBoundary: Windoors and directional windows occupy rotated edges, often with multiple entities on one tile. Whole-tile partitions are deliberately not used to assert precise directional traversability.

limitations: Beacon text is a room-name clue, not an ownership polygon or a department boundary.
A door boundary records adjacent coarse floor components, not a successful runtime traversal.
A repeated native pattern is an observed design preference until explicitly authored as a v3 requirement.
No game server was loaded; atmospherics, power, interaction reach and runtime door behavior were not simulated.
